# TMMT

> Ecommerce infrastructure and marketplace automation systems for D2C and fashion brands.

https://www.tmmt.in

https://www.tmmt.in

## Core Areas

- Ecommerce Automation
- Marketplace Infrastructure
- Shopify Automation
- Inventory Synchronization
- Seller Operations
- Catalog Management
- API Integrations
- Operational Dashboards
